fields.evidence: Ran `npx vitest run --config vitest.node.config.mts tests/reconciliation-assistant-looking-surface.test.ts` (4/13 fail) and `--config vitest.workers.config.mts tests/reconciliation-assistant-looking-surface-worker.workers.test.ts` (1/1 fail), and printed the real outputs. (1) screenshot's tool_result content and the streamed tool_activity meta.output are both the string '<<<untrusted>>>\n[...base64 PNG...]\n<<</untrusted>>>'; the block array is turned into text and nothing calls isContentBlocks, so the model never gets an image block and withoutImageData never strips anything (base64 reaches the SSE stream). (2) Refusals read 'Error: screenshot failed. <message>' with no PICTURE_INVALID/NOT_FOUND code; PictureSourceError/PictureNotFoundError are not mapped to the declared codes. (3) screenshot {kind:'revision', revision:99} on a site with only revision 1 returns a picture instead of NOT_FOUND. (4) apps/control-app/src/ai.ts has no reference to fidelity; workerHost never composes the looking surface (the story's own flagged code issue). Changing the tests to match would mean asserting the model gets base64 as text and the operator stream carries image bytes, the opposite of the story's purpose.
fields.proposed_change: (a) tools/generate/src/cli/ai/fidelity-core.ts (FidelityToolbox) and/or toolbox-core.ts: when an operation returns isContentBlocks(value), pass the block array through as the tool_result content (keeping the untrusted framing as a text block, not by turning the array into text), so host-core's withoutImageData sees an array. (b) Map PictureSourceError -> PICTURE_INVALID and PictureNotFoundError -> NOT_FOUND through the Toolbox's declared-error mechanism, so the refusal text carries the code. (c) In picture.ts resolvePicture, for kind 'revision', check the revision exists in the store and throw PictureNotFoundError if not. (d) apps/control-app/src/ai.ts workerHost: when env has the Browser Rendering binding, set HostDeps.fidelity = (slug) => fidelityDeps(env, new PreviewRenderer(store), references, origin, slug, { launch: bindingLauncher(env) }). No test or AC changes needed; the five tests already state the intended behaviour.

fields.evidence: Ran `npx vitest run --config vitest.node.config.mts tests/test_reconciliation_capture_site_egress.test.ts`: 6 failed / 4 passed. Read tools/generate/src/cli/ai/fidelity-core.ts:245-380 and tools/generate/src/cli/capture/bundle.ts:95-99. readCapture throws `Bundle '<name>' has no capture.json.` on a missing record, so the null fallback in list_references and PictureNotFoundError (NOT_FOUND) in captureOf can never run (AC2045, AC2046). The Playwright double follows Playwright's documented rule that route() is not called for redirect hops; the Node driver therefore forwards a redirect to http://10.0.0.1/ unguarded (AC2048 node). AC2049/AC2050 failures are exactly story code issues 1-4: origin-count redirect cap trips on 8 CDN origins, the Node driver records no response bytes, the 60 s cap is never applied, and capture_site returns a bundle when guard.tripped. The ACs were written as intent the code contradicts; satisfying them in tests alone would mean weakening assertions around an SSRF boundary.
fields.proposed_change: (1) tools/generate/src/cli/capture/bundle.ts: add a tolerant `readCaptureOrNull` (readJson without throw); use it in fidelity-core.ts list_references and captureOf so the null and NOT_FOUND paths run. (2) tools/generate/src/cli/capture/egress guard module: count redirect hops per navigation (document redirect chain only, not subresource origins), and refuse with reason `redirect-cap` beyond 5 hops. (3) tools/generate/src/cli/capture/playwright-driver.ts (guardedPlaywrightDriver): guard redirect hops (on 'response' with a 3xx Location, check the target against the guard and abort navigation / route redirects manually, e.g. by fulfilling the 3xx and re-requesting through the route), and record response bytes against the guard as cf-driver does; stop forwarding once the guard trips. (4) fidelity-core.ts capture_site: wrap cmdCapturePage in a 60 s deadline (AbortSignal/Promise.race that closes the driver) and fail naming the limit; after capture, if guard.tripped (response-cap or redirect-cap) throw `REFUSED: …` and delete/not register the bundle so list_references stays unchanged. (5) Test-only, within the same pass: tests/test_reconciliation_capture_site_egress.test.ts AC2047 `namesAddress` check accepts the refused scheme or credential reason instead of the literal URL for scheme/credential refusals (code deliberately does not echo credentialed URLs), and update AC acceptance_criterion-7db0225c wording to match.
